troubleshooting: Inf/nan errors: Enable Replace Errors and set Error Value
Aspect ratio wrong: Enable Aspect Correct
Component swapping: Use P(1) P(0) P(2) syntax to reorder components
description: Normalizes any attribute to 0-1 range. Supports polar/cylindrical coordinate conversion (radius, latitude, longitude). Post-normalization pipeline: Bias → Lookup Curve → Exponent → Re-range. Handles inf/nan with Replace Errors. Per-component control via Parameter Size.
